player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} a cikin SimpleTak. A kan allon, duwatsun ka suna bayyana a matsayin '{player_stone}' kuma duwatsun abokin adawar ka suna bayyana a matsayin '{opponent_stone}'. A lokacin da kake zagaye, zaɓi ɗayan ɗaki ɗaya (ta hanyar lambar da aka ƙidaya) kuma sanya dutsen ka a can. Misali, '[12]' yana sanya dutsen ka a cikin tantanin halitta 12. Manufarka ita ce samar da hanyar ci gaba da duwatsun ka wanda ke haɗa gefuna biyu na kwamitin (sama zuwa ƙasa ko hagu zuwa dama).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Lambar tantanin halitta mara inganci {cell_num}. Dole ne ya kasance tsakanin 0 da {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Kwayar {cell_num} ta riga ta kasance. Zaɓi wani ɗakin da ba shi da komai.

action.placement: Mai kunnawa {current_player_id} sanya alamar su ({symbol}) a cikin tantanin halitta {cell_num} .

outcome.winner: Mai kunnawa {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') ya haɗa gefuna biyu masu adawa!
outcome.draw: The board is full. It's a draw!
